review.assessment: The change creates `src/lib.rs` and implements `has_duplicate_within_k` using a brute-force nested loop structure. While this passes the provided behavioral test, it completely ignores the explicit requirement to run in roughly linear time regardless of window size `k`. The implementation retains O(N*K) worst-case complexity by scanning forward for each element instead of tracking seen values with a hash set or sliding-window structure.

findings.actual: Nested loop `(i + 1)..=end` causes quadratic time scaling when `k` is large relative to array size.
findings.call: Benchmark with nums.len() = 10^5 and k = 10^4; measure execution time scaling.
findings.expected: Execution should scale linearly O(N) independent of `k`, using a HashSet or equivalent sliding-window state.
